sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Yesterday on the show, our colleagues from the politics desk explained just how much next month's midterm elections
sentences.zh: 昨天在节目中，我们政治新闻组的同事解释了下个月的中期选举在多大程度上

sentences.en: will come down to the decision-making of Republican voters in red states who are now deeply disillusioned with President Trump
sentences.zh: 将取决于红州共和党选民的决策，他们现在对特朗普总统深感失望，

sentences.en: and whether that disillusionment will push them into the arms of Democrats.
sentences.zh: 以及这种失望情绪是否会把他们推向民主党人的怀抱。

sentences.en: Today, Daily producer Anna Foley travels to Iowa, a state Trump and Republicans have dominated for the past decade, to speak with one of those Republican voters
sentences.zh: 今天，《每日新闻》制片人安娜·福利前往爱荷华州——一个特朗普和共和党人在过去十年中一直占据主导地位的州——去采访其中一位共和党选民，

sentences.en: about what he's choosing to do with his frustrations.
sentences.zh: 谈谈他打算如何处理自己的挫败感。

sentences.en: It's Friday, October 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月16日，星期五。

sentences.en: There's corn on the left side of the street, and I think we have soybeans on the right.
sentences.zh: 街道左侧是玉米，我想右侧应该是大豆。

sentences.en: There's an old saying in Iowa that in order to have a good harvest, your corn should be knee-high by the 4th of July.
sentences.zh: 爱荷华州有句老话，为了获得好收成，玉米在7月4日之前应该长到膝盖高。

sentences.en: Hi!
sentences.zh: 嗨！

sentences.en: Sorry, I might smell like gasoline.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我身上可能有汽油味。

sentences.en: Oh no, that's totally fine.
sentences.zh: 哦，没关系，完全没问题。

sentences.en: By the time I flew out to Iowa in late summer, the corn towered over me.
sentences.zh: 当我夏末飞往爱荷华州时，玉米已经长得比我高了。

sentences.en: This is my cornfield right here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的玉米地。

sentences.en: I was there to meet Caleb Renner, a corn and soybean farmer.
sentences.zh: 我到那里是为了见卡莱布·雷纳，一位玉米和大豆种植户。

sentences.en: You can see it's bright yellow on the tip, but as it gets closer to the base, it's more of like a cream-colored.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到顶端是亮黄色的，但越靠近根部，颜色越偏向奶油色。

sentences.en: That's what we call the milk layer.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所说的乳熟层。

sentences.en: Caleb's only 25, but he's been farming for years.
sentences.zh: 卡莱布才25岁，但他已经种了好几年地了。

sentences.en: He's the fifth generation of his family to work these fields, and his folks had him start young.
sentences.zh: 他是家里第五代从事耕作的人，他的父母让他很小就开始干活了。

sentences.en: I loved to ride in the combine with my dad, and my earliest memory is sitting in the combine and thinking I was inside of a spaceship, especially at nighttime.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢坐在我爸的联合收割机里，我最早的记忆就是坐在里面，以为自己身处宇宙飞船中，尤其是在晚上。

sentences.en: It's big open windows you can see all around you, and it's nothing but like a really dark cornfield, and then a bunch of glowing flashing buttons and monitors.
sentences.zh: 窗户很大，你可以看到周围的一切，外面除了漆黑的玉米地，就是一堆闪烁的按钮和显示器。

sentences.en: It was awesome.
sentences.zh: 那感觉太棒了。

sentences.en: Even today, I love sitting in a combine.
sentences.zh: 即使是今天，我也很喜欢坐在收割机里。

sentences.en: Caleb told me another thing he remembered was that growing up, it felt like a given that he was a Republican.
sentences.zh: 卡莱布告诉我，他记得的另一件事是，在成长过程中，他觉得自己理所当然就是共和党人。

sentences.en: I grew up in a very traditional, bright red area.
sentences.zh: 我在一个非常传统、非常“红”的地区长大。

sentences.en: Caleb's county, Hancock County, it's always been a reliably conservative area.
sentences.zh: 卡莱布所在的汉考克县，一直是一个可靠的保守派地区。

sentences.en: But when Trump came on the scene, it went from bright red to deep MAGA red.
sentences.zh: 但当特朗普出现时，这里从亮红色变成了深度的“MAGA红”。

sentences.en: In 2016, Hancock went almost 30 points more to the Republican side.
sentences.zh: 2016年，汉考克县共和党的得票率优势增加了近30个百分点。

sentences.en: Caleb was still in high school at the time, but he remembers how Trump resonated with the people around him.
sentences.zh: 卡莱布当时还在上高中，但他记得特朗普是如何引起周围人共鸣的。

sentences.en: You got to understand what he captured at the time, too.
sentences.zh: 你也得理解他当时抓住了什么。

sentences.en: It was almost like this outsider,
sentences.zh: 他就像是一个局外人，

sentences.en: I'm going to drain the swamp, as he says.
sentences.zh: 正如他所说，我要“抽干沼泽”。

sentences.en: It was also around this time, Caleb says, that he started to hear a lot more that Democrats were the enemy, that the stakes of every election were existentially high.
sentences.zh: 卡莱布说，也是在大约那个时候，他开始更多地听到民主党人是敌人，每场选举的利害关系都关乎生死存亡。

sentences.en: It was like, overnight, it became, the right is against the left, and this tribalism sort of just emerged from,
sentences.zh: 就像一夜之间，变成了右派反对左派，这种部落主义不知从何而来，

sentences.en: I don't know, even nowhere.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，甚至是从虚无中产生的。

sentences.en: It's like, we're fighting a culture war, we're fighting against the liberals, or we're fighting againSt...
sentences.zh: 就像是，我们在打一场文化战争，我们在对抗自由派，或者我们在对抗……

sentences.en: And so, by the time 2020 came around, there was really no question who Caleb's first vote for president would be.
sentences.zh: 所以，到了2020年，卡莱布的第一张总统选票投给谁已经毫无疑问了。

sentences.en: I was definitely on Team Trump in 2020.
sentences.zh: 2020年我绝对是支持特朗普团队的。

sentences.en: I think 2020, I really did not do any, like, I was not very informed at all.
sentences.zh: 我觉得2020年的时候，我真的什么都没做，就是说，我一点都不了解情况。

sentences.en: I just was marking the red box, the Republican box.
sentences.zh: 我只是在红色的方框里打钩，也就是共和党的方框。

sentences.en: I think I was attached to a team, and there was not a lot of convincing
sentences.zh: 我想我当时是依附于一个团队，并没有太多的说服力

sentences.en: to make me think in a more nuanced approach.
sentences.zh: 能让我以更细致的方式去思考。

sentences.en: I had a team, and I'm not going to deviate from that team.
sentences.zh: 我有一个团队，我不会背离那个团队。

sentences.en: And Caleb's team, it was only growing.
sentences.zh: 而卡莱布的团队，还在不断壮大。

sentences.en: His county shifted even further in Trump's direction that year, which, by then, was the story of most counties in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 那一年，他所在的县在特朗普方向上走得更远，而这在当时已经是爱荷华州大多数县的故事了。

sentences.en: Every single time that Trump has been on the ballot there, the state has gotten redder and redder.
sentences.zh: 每次特朗普出现在选票上，这个州就变得越来越红。

sentences.en: Essentially, Trump transformed a state that had voted for Obama twice into a place where Democrats were locked out.
sentences.zh: 本质上，特朗普把一个曾两次投票给奥巴马的州，变成了一个民主党人被拒之门外的地方。

sentences.en: Trump won the state again in 2024, and Caleb was one of the voters to help him do it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在2024年再次赢得了该州，卡莱布就是帮助他获胜的选民之一。

sentences.en: But at that point,
sentences.zh: 但在那个时候，

sentences.en: Caleb was actually thinking more independently about his vote and who he was as a voter.
sentences.zh: 卡莱布实际上开始更独立地思考他的投票，以及他作为一个选民的身份。

sentences.en: I think if I had to put a label on it,
sentences.zh: 我想如果非要给它贴个标签的话，

sentences.en: I'd say I'm a libertarian populiSt.
sentences.zh: 我会说我是一个自由意志主义民粹派。

sentences.en: It's probably the best way that you could describe my politics.
sentences.zh: 这可能是描述我政治立场最好的方式。

sentences.en: I'd like to see our working class do good.
sentences.zh: 我希望看到我们的工人阶级过得好。

sentences.en: I'd like to see manufacturing back in the States and all these things that sort of form my political identity as a populiSt.
sentences.zh: 我希望看到制造业回到美国，所有这些构成了我作为民粹派的政治身份。

sentences.en: With this in mind, he knew there was no way he was going to vote for a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一点，他知道他绝不可能投票给民主党人。

sentences.en: You have to understand, at the time, this is coming on the heels of four years of President Biden who increased a lot of inflation in our economy,
sentences.zh: 你必须明白，当时正值拜登总统执政四年之后，他加剧了我们经济中的通货膨胀，

sentences.en: and that's a big issue with me as a populist is I want things to be cheap and affordable for Americans.
sentences.zh: 作为一个民粹主义者，我非常关心这个问题，我希望美国人的生活成本低廉且负担得起。

sentences.en: So that was a big issue for me at the time.
sentences.zh: 所以那是我当时非常关心的一个大问题。

sentences.en: And the Trump campaign was meeting Caleb where he was.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普的竞选团队正迎合了卡莱布的诉求。

sentences.en: It wasn't just that Trump was talking about the problems facing the working class, but the way he was doing it.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是因为特朗普在谈论工人阶级面临的问题，而是他谈论的方式。

sentences.en: There was a vibe around Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普周围有一种氛围。

sentences.en: Like there was this momentum, this energy that he carried with him.
sentences.zh: 就像有一种势头，一种他随身携带的能量。

sentences.en: Like there was this energy, this vibe.
sentences.zh: 就像有这种能量，这种氛围。

sentences.en: It felt like Trump could actually get things done, which was really important to Caleb at this specific moment.
sentences.zh: 感觉特朗普真的能把事情办成，这对当时的卡莱布来说非常重要。

sentences.en: After years of working his family's farm, he was getting ready to take on his own plot of land.
sentences.zh: 在经营家族农场多年后，他准备接手属于自己的一块土地。

sentences.en: It feels like now, instead of me just washing machinery and cleaning out air filters, it's like I'm farming now.
sentences.zh: 感觉现在，我不再只是清洗机器和清理空气滤清器，而是真的在务农了。

sentences.en: I'm part of the farm.
sentences.zh: 我是农场的一部分。

sentences.en: It's one of the parts, actually, I like the least, is I have to be watching the markets every single day and making sure that...
sentences.zh: 其实，我最不喜欢的部分之一，就是我必须每天盯着市场，确保……

sentences.en: Now he had his own bottom line to worry about.
sentences.zh: 现在他有自己的盈亏底线需要担心了。

sentences.en: And so, as Trump took office,
sentences.zh: 所以，当特朗普上任时，

sentences.en: Caleb watched and waited and hoped to see the affordability agenda he voted for come into focus and make his life better.
sentences.zh: 卡莱布观察着、等待着，希望能看到他所投票支持的“负担能力议程”能够落实，让他的生活变得更好。

sentences.en: The first big test,
sentences.zh: 第一个重大考验，

sentences.en: April 2nd, 2025.
Liberation Day.
sentences.zh: 解放日。

sentences.en: Liberation Day.
sentences.zh: 解放日。

sentences.en: It's quite the day.
sentences.zh: 那真是个特别的日子。

sentences.en: Initially, I thought that that would be fantastic because what we do is we tighten up the trade deficit that we have and then we bring a lot of the manufacturing
sentences.zh: 起初，我认为那会很棒，因为我们要做的就是收紧我们的贸易逆差，然后把很多被送到海外的制造业

sentences.en: that was sent overseas back to America.
sentences.zh: 带回美国。

sentences.en: I want jobs for Americans.
sentences.zh: 我想要美国人的就业机会。

sentences.en: Trump announced a whole slate of tariffs on foreign imports that would, in his telling, make life better for all kinds of domestic workers, including farmers.
sentences.zh: 特朗普宣布了一系列针对外国进口商品的关税，按照他的说法，这将改善包括农民在内的各类国内工人的生活。

sentences.en: And that didn't seem to happen.
sentences.zh: 但事情似乎并没有那样发生。

sentences.en: What happened instead was that the soybean market tanked.
sentences.zh: 相反，大豆市场崩盘了。

sentences.en: In retaliation for Trump's tariffs,
sentences.zh: 为了报复特朗普的关税，

sentences.en: China stopped importing soybeans from American farmers.
sentences.zh: 中国停止了从美国农民那里进口大豆。

sentences.en: And prices for Caleb's beans dropped.
sentences.zh: 卡莱布的大豆价格随之下跌。

sentences.en: I mean, last year I sold my soybeans for, like, it was pathetic.
sentences.zh: 我是说，去年我卖大豆的价格，简直太可怜了。

sentences.en: Wait, pathetic how?
sentences.zh: 等等，怎么个可怜法？

sentences.en: It was $9.20 a bushel for soybeans or something like that out of the field.
sentences.zh: 地里产出的大豆每蒲式耳才9.20美元左右。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's not a good price.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那不是个好价格。

sentences.en: For us to be making money off of soybeans, we want it around $12.
sentences.zh: 我们要想靠大豆赚钱，价格得在12美元左右。

sentences.en: We'd like it a lot more if it was above $12.
sentences.zh: 如果能超过12美元，我们会更高兴。

sentences.en: You can make money off of $9.20 soybeans, but you need to be very meticulous with how you manage that field and reduce all of the inputs in it.
sentences.zh: 靠9.20美元的大豆也能赚钱，但你必须非常精细地管理那块地，并减少所有的投入成本。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How did you do that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: How did you meticulously manage the field?
sentences.zh: 你是如何精细管理那块地的？

sentences.en: I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我没做到。

sentences.en: I took a loss.
sentences.zh: 我亏损了。

sentences.en: That's just simple as it can get.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这么简单。

sentences.en: I lost money that year.
sentences.zh: 那一年我赔钱了。

sentences.en: It's not easy taking a hit like that.
sentences.zh: 遭受这样的打击并不容易。

sentences.en: And we lean a lot on our faith during these times.
sentences.zh: 在这些时候，我们非常依赖我们的信仰。

sentences.en: And when it's something like bean prices, it's out of my hands.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到大豆价格这类事情时，我无能为力。

sentences.en: I can't do anything about that.
sentences.zh: 我对此无计可施。

sentences.en: And when it's out of my hands, there really ain't nothing else that I can do besides pray about it.
sentences.zh: 当事情超出我的掌控时，除了祈祷，我真的什么也做不了。

sentences.en: Did you draw the line between, like, what you were experiencing and Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 你有没有把你所经历的这一切和唐纳德·特朗普联系起来？

sentences.en: I'm sure I was very aware that Donald Trump was enacting tariffs against China and that had a negative effect on the bean price.
sentences.zh: 我很清楚唐纳德·特朗普正在对中国实施关税，这对大豆价格产生了负面影响。

sentences.en: It was enough to make Caleb begin to doubt if the president actually had his back.
sentences.zh: 这足以让卡莱布开始怀疑总统是否真的在支持他。

sentences.en: And then, this past February,
sentences.zh: 然后，在去年二月，

sentences.en: Trump did something else that seemed almost tailor-made to hurt Caleb's bottom line.
sentences.zh: 特朗普又做了一件事，似乎简直就是为了损害卡莱布的利益而量身定做的。

sentences.en: I got a notification on my phone and we bombed one of their nuclear facilities.
sentences.zh: 我手机收到通知，我们轰炸了他们的一处核设施。

sentences.en: The war with Iran.
sentences.zh: 与伊朗的战争。

sentences.en: How did you connect the push notification to the farm?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么把这条推送通知和农场联系起来的？

sentences.en: So, I don't think it set in for me initially that that would have an effect on the farm from an input perspective.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不认为我最初意识到这会从投入角度对农场产生影响。

sentences.en: Like, I don't think anybody knew how that was going to play out or the downstream effects of it until, I want to say, like, maybe a month later or so
sentences.zh: 就像，我不认为有人知道事情会如何发展，或者它的连锁反应会怎样，直到，我想说，大概一个月左右之后，

sentences.en: when we truly understood the scale of it.
sentences.zh: 当我们真正理解了它的规模时。

sentences.en: Once the trade of Hormuz was blocked, those downstream effects came for Caleb.
sentences.zh: 一旦霍尔木兹海峡的贸易被封锁，那些连锁反应就波及到了卡莱布。

sentences.en: So, initially, economically, from a farm perspective, we saw it at the pump with diesel.
sentences.zh: 所以，最初从经济上，从农场的角度来看，我们在柴油加油站看到了影响。

sentences.en: First off, diesel fuel, an essential part of operating heavy machinery on the farm, got more and more expensive.
sentences.zh: 首先，柴油，作为农场重型机械运行的重要组成部分，变得越来越贵。

sentences.en: By the time Caleb and I were talking in late summer, the average price of diesel was more than $5.50.
sentences.zh: 当我和卡莱布在夏末交谈时，柴油的平均价格已经超过了5.50美元。

sentences.en: That's almost 50% more than when the war began.
sentences.zh: 这比战争开始时高出了近50%。

sentences.en: So, when it comes to synthetic fertilizer, there's a lot of resources from the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，说到合成肥料，有很多资源来自中东。

sentences.en: Fertilizer prices climbed, too.
sentences.zh: 肥料价格也上涨了。

sentences.en: You know, that is making farming more expensive from a fertilizer perspective.
sentences.zh: 你知道，从肥料的角度来看，这让务农成本更高了。

sentences.en: Suddenly, his entire farming operation began to feel at risk.
sentences.zh: 突然间，他整个农场的运营都开始感到风险。

sentences.en: And he wasn't just stressed about the present situation.
sentences.zh: 他不仅为当前的局势感到压力。

sentences.en: He was looking way down the road, worrying just how long it would take for prices to come down.
sentences.zh: 他还在展望未来，担心价格回落需要多长时间。

sentences.en: I just am very worried about the downstream effects.
